meta.name: poetry-music-visual
meta.description: 为古诗词提供配图与配乐的全流程创作指导；支持深度解析诗词意境、生成画面描述、提供配乐创作蓝图（Suno格式）；适用于诗词可视化、MV创作、文化传播等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为古诗词生成配图与配乐创作方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把古诗词转化为视听作品
copy.tagline_en: Generate visual and music creation plans for classical poetry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform classical poetry into audiovisual works

howto.what: 为古诗词生成配图配乐方案：先解析意象、情感与文化背景，再输出2-3组配图场景描述，最后按Suno格式给出纯音乐创作蓝图。
howto.when: 当用户要求为古诗词配图、配乐或制作诗词MV时触发。

say.text: 为李白的《静夜思》做配图方案和配乐蓝图
say.note: Claude会解析诗意并输出画面描述与Suno格式音乐指令。

say.text: 给王维《山居秋暝》生成配乐，风格要宁静
say.note: 会产出含风格标签与结构指令的Suno蓝图。

say.text: 帮我给《春晓》设计配图，要水墨风
say.note: 会输出2-3组配图场景描述。

howto.what_en: Generates visual and musical designs for classical Chinese poetry: first analyzes imagery, emotion, and cultural context, then outputs 2-3 scene descriptions for illustrations, and finally provides a Suno-format blueprint for instrumental music.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for illustration, music, or an MV based on a classical Chinese poem.

say_en.text: Create an illustration plan and music blueprint for Li Bai's 'Quiet Night Thought'.
Generate music for Wang Wei's 'Autumn Evening in the Mountains', calm style.
say_en.note: Produces a Suno blueprint with style tags and structure instructions.
